'''New Atraken City''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] located half a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] below the surface of [[Trilos]]. Originally a small community for [[Miner/Legends|miners]] and their families, the evacuation of [[Atraken/Legends|Atraken]] and the influx of [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] pushed the population up to around 40,000 by [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. New Atraken City was connected to [[Starport Touchdown]] via access paths, and by double-track subway to the [[Old Mine]]. Two [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], the [[Last Resort]] and [[Downside (cantina)|Downside]], were located in New Atraken City.
